title: TradeDecision
description: Standardized trade decision contract produced by Person 3 decision intelligence engine (Interface Contract C)

decision_id.description: Unique UUID or deterministic hash identifying this decision

decision_timestamp.description: ISO 8601 UTC timestamp when decision was reached

selected_action.description: Action chosen by the decision engine

target_quantity_or_exposure.description: Target position exposure fraction (-1.0 to 1.0) or target shares

expected_gross_return.description: Expected gross return decimal fraction before friction

estimated_all_in_cost.description: Estimated all-in friction decimal fraction (fees, spread, slippage)

expected_net_return.description: Expected net return decimal fraction: gross - all_in_cost

probability_of_clearing_costs.description: Estimated probability that gross return exceeds all-in costs

selected_strategy.description: Identifier of strategy or ensemble that generated the decision

selection_or_rejection_reasons.description: List of explicit human-readable reason codes

model_versions.description: Mapping of model names to versions utilized in decision

configuration_version.description: Version string of the running configuration
